description:
Port the upstream `openai-completions` API dialect from `tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts` as a new umbrella app `octo_pi_ai_openai`. Registers `:openai_completions` in the ProviderRegistry.

This is the most versatile provider — covers OpenAI, xAI/Grok, Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, Fireworks, HuggingFace, MiniMax, Kimi, DeepSeek via a single implementation with a 16-field compat layer that tunes behavior per-provider.

Follows the pattern established by `octo_pi_ai_anthropic` (Provider behaviour, Producer, Decoder, Request, Application). TDD throughout — port upstream tests first, then implement.

Port map: `docs/port-map/openai-completions.md`
Upstream: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts`
title: OpenAI Completions provider (octo_pi_ai_openai)
